quarterly_data.quarter: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (Jan-Jun 2026): net sales JPY 139,668 million (+25.1% year on year), operating income JPY 28,854 million (+45.4%), ordinary income JPY 30,272 million (+48.5%), net income attributable to owners JPY 20,409 million (+49.9%). Electronic Functional Materials sales JPY 74,155 million (+27.5%); High-Purity Chemicals JPY 63,008 million (+21.2%). Management states that in the electronics market, semiconductor demand exceeded the prior-year period on expanding demand for AI servers for data centers. H1 R&D spending JPY 9,259 million; micro resist technology GmbH was newly consolidated in the period.
